lastCompletedStory.title: Render a distinct operator-paused state in cam status

nextStoryContext: StatusState (src/commands/status.ts) is now 'idle' | 'active' | 'paused' | 'operator-paused'. buildStatusReport computes `operatorPaused = isPauseSet(claudeDir)` (imported from src/supervisor/pause-marker.ts, US-001) right after the existing state/prd/git reads, then overrides `report.state = 'operator-paused'` in BOTH exit paths (the early no-state-file return AND after the phase-derived `state.active === false ? 'paused' : 'active'` assignment) so the marker always wins, regardless of whether a loop state file exists. renderStateIndicator's param type is now the full `StatusState` union (was previously a narrower inline literal) and gained an `operator-paused` branch: reuses `glyphs.warning` ('!') but pairs it with `destructive` (red) instead of `warning` (yellow) and the label 'operator-paused', so it reads as visually distinct from the plain 'paused' row at a glance -- no new glyph token was added to src/design/tokens.ts, this story intentionally recombined the existing warning glyph with a different color instead. runStatus's trailing-hint block (previously a single `if (report.state === 'paused')`) is now an if/else-if: `operator-paused` prints its own emitWarn('Loop is operator-paused', '(.cam-pause marker present)') + a `cam resume` hint, and the plain `paused` branch is unchanged and mutually exclusive (verified by an explicit test asserting the plain-paused hint text does NOT appear when the marker is set, and vice versa). IMPORTANT gotcha for any future story touching status.ts + a claudeDir-scoped marker: buildStatusReport's default `claudeDir` (when the caller omits `options.claudeDir`) resolves to `process.env['CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR'] ?? join(os.homedir(), '.claude')` -- i.e. the REAL machine home directory, not something scoped to the test's cwd tmpdir. All new tests in test/commands/status-paused.test.ts therefore pass an explicit `claudeDir` tmp subdir to `buildStatusReport`/`runStatus` (never rely on the default) so they stay hermetic and never accidentally read a real operator's `~/.claude/.cam-pause` marker on the dev machine. This mirrors how the pre-existing tokens/transcript tests in test/status.test.ts already pass an explicit claudeDir for the same reason. File-size ceiling raised for src/commands/status.ts (612->636) in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a dated _ref note citing CAM-360/US-003; the change is staged and committed.
